prompt: I need to create a comprehensive brand guidelines document for our marketing team. Generate a multi-slide PowerPoint presentation that showcases Anthropic's complete brand identity including: (1) a title slide with company branding, (2) a color palette reference slide showing all primary and accent colors with their hex codes, (3) a typography showcase demonstrating heading and body text styles, (4) a practical application slide showing how colors work together in charts/graphics, and (5) a brand usage examples slide. Make sure everything follows proper Anthropic visual standards and includes both light and dark theme examples. The presentation should be production-ready for our Q1 brand rollout.
